blockerSchema.taskId: string or null — task that is blocked
blockerSchema.owner: string — who can resolve this (role, person, or external party)
blockerSchema.decisionNeeded: string — what decision or action would unblock
blockerSchema.unblockCondition: string — measurable condition that proves the blocker is resolved
blockerSchema.resolution: string or null — how the blocker was resolved

notes: Blockers must state what is blocked, why, owner/decision needed, and the condition that would unblock the work. Move resolved blockers from active to resolved with a resolution note; do not delete them.
